thread:
Maya (partnerships): Quick heads-up — QuantStack preview kicks off next Tue (May 12). Need final NDA, benchmark plan, and shipping ops aligned. Who can own bench validation? cc @Sam @Jules @Priya
Sam (partner-ops): I can own shipping + lab access. ETA on rack/cabinet confirmation? Need power/cooling numbers to pass to logistics.
Jules (hw-eng): I can take rack & test runs. Can we get unit serials + firmware image IDs now? Also need PCIe layout for board pairing.
Priya (bench): I'll lead the benchmark suite. Which workload profiles do we want — single-stream latency, 2x batch throughput, mixed? Propose: 8k seq single-stream, 4k batch 2, and a small 0.5 token/sample quality sweep. Also want quality regression vs our baseline v1.2.
Maya (partnerships): Goal = perf baseline + quality regression check vs redwood/v1.2. Partner legal has an NDA draft but we need sign-off on our side. Nate, can you take point?
Nate (legal): I will review NDA tomorrow AM. Please send the partner's draft + any redlines. We need telemetry/IP carveouts called out (no partner access to raw request payloads).
Priya (bench): Prototype run command for infra to validate metrics export:
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 8192 --batch 1 --quant int8 --report metrics.json
```
We'll capture token-level latencies and p99/p99.9. Also export perf traces to S3 for triage.
Jules (hw-eng): Lab notes: rack needs 2U space, PCIe x16 slot, 2x 1U fans spare. Sam — can you confirm shipping labels + customs docs? Plan is 2-day soak then 1 day regression tests.
Sam (partner-ops): Shipping labels created; ETA arrival Mon 11. Booking rack now, will share tracking and customs numbers.
Maya (partnerships): Can someone own the partner feedback loop doc? Need a template capturing: perf numbers, regressions, infra issues, logs, and action items with owners.
Priya (bench): I'll draft the feedback template and put it in Partnerships drive. Will include charts (latency histogram, p50/p95/p99), failure triage checklist, and a section for vendor firmware notes.
DeployBot: Calendar event created: "QuantStack Preview — Lab Week" Tue-Fri May 12-15. Invitees: Maya, Sam, Jules, Priya, Nate.
Maya (partnerships): :thumbsup: Action items: Nate - NDA by EOD Tue; Sam - shipping + rack by Thu; Jules - firmware + infra checks by Fri; Priya - bench doc + runner by Mon. I'll schedule a weekly sync with partner for status.
Priya (bench): Noted. I'll also run a small warm-up with dummy inputs to validate metrics pipeline to S3 and perfcollector.
Jules (hw-eng): If harness needs GPU-exclusive mode or PCIe PASSTHROUGH, ping eng-runtime. I'll reserve GPU nodes and set isolation.
Sam (partner-ops): Partner asked about a joint announcement embargo window — might need marketing. Keeping them looped but we'll hold public comms until perf & legal signoff.
Maya (partnerships): Adding marketing on the announcement thread separately. For now let's treat it as embargoed. Any blockers?
Priya (bench): One potential blocker: quantization path on partner firmware has a different kernel that may change token timing. Will run small comparison asap and flag regressions.
Jules (hw-eng): Got it. If we see kernel mismatch, we'll capture kernel versions and revert to vendor-provided stable image for regression runs.
Maya (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll post a short checklist in the drive and tag owners.
Sam (partner-ops): Will share tracking + rack slot by EOD.
Nate (legal): NDA invite sent to partner counsel. Please attach any telemetry spec in the thread.
Priya (bench): Uploading initial bench doc draft to the drive now. Link will follow.
Maya (partnerships): Perfect — keeping this thread for day-zero coordination. :rocket:
